design_rules: Routing widths are saved netclass defaults, not enforced current limits. Base calculations use external35um nominal copper with31.5um calculation thickness,20C trace rise budget,70C copper resistivity, and<=50mm power trunk lengths with<=50mV drop per trunk. Recalculate for longer/hotter/thinner paths;70um copper is not configured or assumed.

Use netclass values for full-current trunks: INPUT_POWER4.5mm at6A envelope;BUS_POWER6mm at8A;PHASE_POWER3.5mm at5A;O1_POWER4.5mm at6A routing envelope only;S2E_POWER2.5mm at3.2A. These are sizing envelopes, not measured loads, guaranteed ILIM, fuse fault clearing or O1 5A load settings.

Keep B.Cu as a continuous GND reference where practical. Keep SW copper compact and FB/COMP/RT/ILIM/IMON away from SW. Route ISNS/VOUT sense branches as Kelvin connections to respective shunt pads; their0.25mm low-current branches are intentional manual-width exceptions to power-net defaults. Large trunk widths must not be started blindly at fine-pitch pads; fanout/neckdowns require a short-path/current review.
U1.10,U2.10,U2.7,U3.7,U4.7 are intentional NC. NC_DO_NOT_ROUTE is a name/guidance, not a KiCad routing ban. Do not route any copper, labels, testpoints or ground ties to these pads.

O1 port is NOT qualified:5-12V device rating versusTPS259824O16.9V typical OVP. Do not connect O1 or claim production readiness before a validated protection revision. F1 MPN/footprint/interrupt rating/I2t remain unresolved. Do not infer a fault-current limit from nominal RILIM or simulation pass.

Netclass via geometry is only a starting geometry:signals0.8/0.4mm pad/drill;power1.2/0.6mm. A single power via is not approved for full trunk current. Minimum plating, via count/distribution, thermal-via stencil treatment and fault I2t require calculation and fabrication confirmation.

Prototype LM70880_RRX0029B_RectLands is an approximate copper decomposition with production stencil/thermal acceptance open. Preserve logical pad-to-net mapping including repeated29(VIN) and22(SW) pieces. No manufacture exports or DRC waivers may bypass this open acceptance.
